title: ml.update_model_snapshot
description:
Update a snapshot.

Updates certain properties of a snapshot.

description.description: A description of the model snapshot.

retain.description:
If `true`, this snapshot will not be deleted during automatic cleanup of
snapshots older than `model_snapshot_retention_days`. However, this
snapshot will be deleted when the job is deleted.

job_id.description: Identifier for the anomaly detection job.
